title: install-local: composed artifacts read package-owned collections from the top level only (translationsLoaded 0; global-unique gate sees no objects)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pHNFS9mn8hS13iGyL

Family card for the out-of-scope findings of #34336 (os-dev-report 6917684209), filed by the `repo:objectstack#1` seat's route. Same defect class as #34336: on a composed artifact (ADR-0130 D4) a collection lives in `packages[i]`, and install-local reads only the top level. PR #34403 fixes the seed datasets through `resolveStackCollection`; these two readers are left.

**Business reason.** A composed app installed through install-local shows untranslated labels (zh-CN users see raw keys or the source language), and the global-unique install ceremony checks nothing for it.

**Items**

- [ ] **1. Translations (measured).** `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` answers `translationsLoaded: 0` for a composed bundle whose package body carries translations; the same translations on a flat bundle answer 1. Scratch run in the #34336 worktree, not committed. Cause: `applySideEffects` step 1 reads `manifest.translations` from the top level only (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). Fix shape: `resolveStackCollection(manifest, 'translations')`. Not measured: whether the hosted UI gets these labels by another path.
- [ ] **2. Global-unique gate (code-read only, not reproduced).** `evaluateGlobalUniqueGate` (ADR-0120 D5e) runs `collectGlobalUniques(manifest?.objects)`, a top-level read, so on a composed artifact the ceremony would see no objects. Reproduce red-first before fixing.

**Grade.** p2 (seat route).

**Reader.** `domain:server`, packages/cloud-connection. Serial after PR #34403 (same file).

**Dedupe.** Searches: "composed translations install-local" (22 hits; #34336, #34396 related, none about translations), "translationsLoaded composed" (2: #34336, a seat archive), "global-unique composed" (26, none), "collectGlobalUniques" (3: #34336, #9022 and #24040 closed, other defects).
